summary: - **[key4hep/k4geo#676](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/676)** — The ALLEGRO turbine ECAL endcap now places the unit cells of each wheel in a dedicated LAr mother volume, so Geant4 voxelises the three wheels separately. Time to first event drops from about 175 s to 104 s single-threaded and from 120 s to 40 s with 8 threads, and peak RSS falls by about 2 GB. Per-event cost is unchanged in 10k-event, 8-thread production-like jobs. A reconstruction-level bug found during review was fixed before merge.

- **[key4hep/k4Gen#67](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/67)** — Fixes several unit errors in generator inputs: GaussSmearVertex time smearing was about 300 times too small and is now converted correctly to HepMC's c·t convention. HepEVTReader and MDIReader now convert production times to ns. The HepMC file readers now convert events, including the root vertex position, to GeV and mm regardless of the units stored in the file.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1712](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1712)** — Makes DetElement nominal/survey alignment and VolumeManager creation thread-safe. These objects are lazily created, and concurrent first access caused crashes when running ALLEGRO with multi-threaded ddsim. (see also **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1713](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1713)**, which makes DetElement path and placementPath computation thread-safe.)

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#119](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/119)** — GGTFTrackFinder gets a major CPU-time and memory optimisation. The clustering step is reimplemented in plain C++, removing the LibTorch dependency from k4RecTracker entirely. ONNX Runtime graph optimisations are enabled, and a new InferenceThreads property (default 1) controls intra-op threading.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#120](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/120)** — GenfitTrackFitter no longer writes empty placeholder tracks (chi2 = ndf = −1, no track states) when all fit attempts fail. Failed fits are now dropped from FittedTracks and FittedTracksWithFilteredHits. As a result, the output collections are no longer index-aligned with the input, which may affect downstream code that relied on that alignment.

- **[key4hep/k4RecCalorimeter#295](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/295)** — Improves CPU and memory use of the calorimeter cell-noise tools. Code duplicated between ReadNoiseFromFileTool and the FCCee noise tools is consolidated into a common base class, and the cell-ID-to-bin lookup is cached. Results are verified identical for ALLEGRO.

- **[key4hep/EDM4hep#543](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/543)** — Adds the GeneratorRandomSeed and SimulationRandomSeed metadata label constants, so random seeds can be recorded in file-level metadata for production provenance. Reviewers noted that DD4hep already stores its seed under a different key at run level, so the conventions still need to be documented or aligned. (see also **[key4hep/EDM4hep#548](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/548)**, which adds a ReconstructionRandomSeed label.)

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#167](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/167)** — Delphes output files now record the generator and Delphes random seeds in the file metadata, and the metadata frame is always written. The Gaudi-wrapped algorithm records only the simulation seed. (see also **[key4hep/k4Gen#69](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Gen/pull/69)**, which records the Pythia8 seed from PythiaInterface and requires EDM4hep > 1.2.)

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#165](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/165)** — The compression of EDM4hep ROOT output from Delphes is now configurable and defaults to zstd level 5. This gives about 13% smaller files and up to 50% faster read-back at negligible production cost. Requires podio > 1.9.

- **[key4hep/k4DetectorPerformance#10](https://github.com/key4hep/k4DetectorPerformance/pull/10)** — Fixes truth reference parameters and track–particle matching in TrackingValidation, and aligns the matching with ACTS definitions: Truth z0 and d0 are now taken at the closest approach to the beamline, which corrects results for vertices away from the origin and for displaced particles. Subset MC collections are now handled correctly. Validated on CLD samples.
